vo.en: You’re being legally kidnapped by stores.

visual.description: A man walking rapidly through a dark, neon-lit corridor that seems to have no end.

vo.en: That furniture maze isn't a mistake; it’s a psychological prison designed to make you lose track of time.

visual.description: A top-down view of a complex wooden maze with a small figure trying to find the exit.

vo.en: It’s called the Gruen Effect, intentionally overwhelming your brain so you forget your shopping list.

visual.description: Macro close-up of a man's eye looking side to side quickly as lights reflect in his pupil.

vo.en: Wait until you see the creepy part: the Bulla Bulla technique.

visual.description: A flood of bright, colorful plastic balls or small objects falling into a massive pile.

vo.en: They dump giant bins of cheap items everywhere to trigger a bargain reflex, forcing you to buy on impulse.

visual.description: Close-up of hands rapidly grabbing different small items from a bin and throwing them into a cart.

vo.en: You entered for one lightbulb, but you’re leaving with a full cart and a headache.

visual.description: A man pushing a heavily loaded shopping trolley through a sliding glass door at night.

vo.en: Subscribe to escape the matrix and comment your most useless purchase, because you're actually...

visual.description: A close-up of a finger pressing a glowing digital button on a glass screen.
